en: Micah 7

p.src: 1  Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

ja: ああ、なんと惨めなのか。
め終えた後、 ぶどう畑で
はなく、 私が切に求める
なりのいちじくもない。
en: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
u.src: 1  Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

p.src: 2  The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

ja: から消え、 人々の中に
en: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
u.src: 2  The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

p.src: 3  Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

ja: らは結託してそれを実行する。
en: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
u.src: 3  Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

p.src: 4  The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

ja: も、いばらのようであり、
より悪い。 あなたの
en: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.
u.src: 4  The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

p.src: 5  Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

ja: じるな。 友を頼りにするな。 あなたが胸に抱く
en: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!
u.src: 5  Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

p.src: 6  For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

en: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
u.src: 6  For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

p.src: 7  But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

ja: は私の声に耳を傾けられる。
en: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
u.src: 7  But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

p.src: 8  Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.

en: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
u.src: 8  Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.

p.src: 9  I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

en: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.
u.src: 9  I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

p.src: 10  Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

ja: はそれを見て、 「あなたの
en: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
u.src: 10  Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

p.src: 11  A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.

en: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
u.src: 11  A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.

p.src: 12  In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

ja: 々はアッシリアから、 エジプトの
る。 エジプトから大河まで、 海から海まで、 山から山まで来る。
en: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
u.src: 12  In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

p.src: 13  Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

ja: てる。 彼らの行いが結んだ実のために。
en: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
u.src: 13  Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

p.src: 14  Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

ja: してください。 あなたの相続の群れを。 彼らは森の
んでいる。 いにしえの
々のように、肥沃な牧草地で、 バシャンとギルアデで
en: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
u.src: 14  Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

p.src: 15  “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

ja: らに驚くべきことを見せる。」
en: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
u.src: 15  “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

p.src: 16  The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

en: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
u.src: 16  The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

p.src: 17  They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.

ja: のようにちりをなめる。
うもののように、巣穴から
れおののきながら来て、 あなたのゆえに震える。
en: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.
u.src: 17  They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.

p.src: 18  Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

ja: がほかにいるだろうか。 あなたは不義を
ごされる。 いつまでも
en: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
u.src: 18  Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

p.src: 19  He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

ja: びわれわれをあわれみ、 われわれの不義を
みつけられる。 あなたは
en: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
u.src: 19  He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

p.src: 20  You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

ja: あなたはヤコブにまことを、 アブラハムに慈しみを示される。 いにしえの
en: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
u.src: 20  You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
